databaseVersion: PostgreSQL 18.6 on x86_64-pc-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Ubuntu 7.5.0-3ubuntu1~18.04) 7.5.0, 64-bit
environment: Isolated loopback PostgreSQL, synthetic credentials and synthetic ledger only

checks.name: Two independent cold starts create one table and one ledger row
Anonymous and authenticated web roles cannot select or mutate the ledger
RLS remains default-deny even with a temporary SELECT grant
Fifty grants across two independent processes preserve every update
A concurrent identical credit is committed only once
A concurrent identical debit opens one deposit and deducts only once
A callback failure rolls back cash, ledger, audit and idempotency metadata
An over-budget business action leaves the stored ledger unchanged
A fresh application process reads the committed ledger without reset
A database stop and restart preserves the exact ledger snapshot

limitations: Supabase/Supavisor connectivity, TLS and pooler behavior are not exercised by a local PostgreSQL instance.
Netlify live Functions and scheduled triggers are not exercised.
